Important notices

What you need to know

Free delivery — no minimum order, no hidden charges

ayoubcomputers.com provides complimentary delivery to every district across Lebanon, with absolutely no minimum order requirement. This applies to all orders — whether fulfilled by Ayoub Computers, an authorised retail partner, or a marketplace vendor — with no exceptions and no additional fees at checkout.

Weekend delivery policy

All estimated delivery timelines are calculated in business days only and explicitly exclude Saturday and Sunday. Saturday deliveries may occur but operate at minimal capacity via our in-house logistics team. Sunday deliveries are not available. Customers should not rely on weekend delivery as a confirmed option.

Stock availability & delay disclaimer

In rare cases of product unavailability or supply chain challenges, delivery may be extended by 1–2 additional business days beyond the initially estimated date. Our team will contact you promptly to confirm whether you wish to proceed or explore alternative arrangements. Your choice will be fully respected.

⚠ Southern border restriction — active notice

Due to ongoing military activity at the southern border, our logistics partners are currently unable to deliver to villages within 5–7 km of the border. This restriction applies to all logistics providers including Aramex, .Net Logistics, Delivery Hub, and our in-house team. We apologise for this inconvenience and will update this notice as the security situation changes. Customers placing orders for affected areas will be contacted directly.
